name: Brutalizer
entriesHtml:
Brutal Weaponry.

You can wield a weapon that has the 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed property in one hand, provided your other hand isn't also wielding a weapon that has the 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed property or holding a Shield.

Killing Streak.

When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed property, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action|XPHB later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a L|XPHB|Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative or you have the Two-Weapon Fighting feat.

name: Cannoneer
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Cannon Proficiency.

You gain proficiency with Cannon, and you can reload a Cannon as a Bonus Action|XPHB instead of an action. You can take this Bonus Action|XPHB only if you haven't moved during your turn, and after you take the Bonus Action|XPHB, your Speed|XPHB is 0 until the end of your turn. Starting at character level 11, this doesn't reduce your Speed|XPHB, and when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with reloading the Cannon. When you reach character level 20, you can ignore the SGEHPP:Art|SGEHPP|Artillery property of Cannon.

Siege.

Your attacks with Cannon deal double damage to objects and structures.

Strong Back.

The weight of Cannon and Cannonball count as half for you.

name: Faithful
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Divine Clarity.

If you fail a saving throw against the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Trial of Faith.

Whenever you roll a 1 on a d20 Test|XPHB, you gain Heroic Inspiration|XPHB.

name: Grizzled
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Overcome.

Whenever you make a saving throw against the Frightened condition, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

Survive.

You require half as much food and water to survive, and you have Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to forage for food and water.

Withstand.

Immediately after you take damage that causes you to be Bloodied|XPHB, you gain Heroic Inspiration|XPHB. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.
